questions.text: Who is referred to by the titles 'Batool' and 'Zahra' in Islamic tradition?
questions.explanation: The titles 'Batool' and 'Zahra' refer to Hazrat Fatima (R.A), the beloved daughter of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ahl e bait.

questions.text: Who was the parental grandmother of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: The parental grandmother of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was Fatimah bint Amr. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ahl e bait.

questions.text: Who was the ten-year-old cousin of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who accepted Islam early?
questions.explanation: The ten-year-old cousin of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who accepted Islam early was Hazrat Ali ibn Abi Talib (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ahl e bait.

questions.text: Which family member of Hazrat Hussain was also martyred at Karbala at the age of six months?
questions.explanation: The six-month-old infant martyred at Karbala was Hazrat Ali al-Asghar, the youngest son of Hazrat Hussain (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ahl e bait.

questions.text: Who holds the title of Sayyidatu nisa-alamin in Islamic history?
questions.explanation: The title Sayyidatu nisa-alamin (Leader of the Women of the Worlds) is held by Hazrat Fatima (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ahl e bait.

questions.text: What was the relationship of Hazrat Ali (RA) to the Holy Prophet (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Ali (RA) was the first cousin and son-in-law of the Holy Prophet (PBUH). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ahl e bait.

questions.text: Which companion of the Prophet (PBUH) is among the Ashra Mubashra?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Saad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) is among the Ashra Mubashra, the ten companions promised Paradise by the Prophet (PBUH). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ashra mubashra (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: How many companions of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) are referred to as Ashra-e-Mubashra, who were given the glad tidings of Paradise?
questions.explanation: The Ashra-e-Mubashra refers to 10 companions of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who were given the glad tidings of Paradise during their lifetime. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ashra mubashra.

questions.text: Which companion of the Prophet (PBUH) is not included among the Ashara-e-Mubashara, the ten companions promised paradise?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Abu Huraira (RA) is not among the Ashara-e-Mubashara, although he is one of the most prolific narrators of Hadith. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ashra mubashra.

questions.text: Who among the following is the brother-in-law of Hazrat Umar (RA) and also one of the Ashra-e-Mubashra?
questions.explanation: Sa'id ibn Zayd is the brother-in-law of Hazrat Umar (RA) and also among the Ashra-e-Mubashra. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ashra mubashra.

questions.text: Who among the Ashra Mubashara was honored with the title of Amin-ul-Ummat?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Abu-Ubaidah Bin Al-Jirrah (RA) was honored with the title Amin-ul-Ummat (Custodian of the Ummah) by the Holy Prophet (PBUH). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ashra mubashra.

questions.text: What is the significance of the term 'Ashra Mubashra' in Islamic history?
questions.explanation: The term 'Ashra Mubashra' refers to the ten companions promised Paradise by the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) during their lifetime. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ashra mubashra.

questions.text: To which tribe did Hazrat Usman (R.A) belong?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Usman (R.A) belonged to the Banu Umayyah tribe of the Quraysh. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, ashra mubashra.

questions.text: In which year did Hazrat Ume Kalsoom (RA) pass away?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Ume Kalsoom (RA) passed away in 630 AD. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Where was Hazrat Bibi Fatima (RA) born?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Bibi Fatima (RA) was born in Makkah. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: Who was the second daughter of the Holy Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
questions.explanation: The second daughter of the Holy Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was Hazrat Ruqayyah (RA). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: Who was the eldest son of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: The eldest son of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was Hazrat Qasim, who was born to Hazrat Khadija (R.A) and passed away in infancy. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: Who was the third daughter of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ)?
questions.explanation: The third daughter of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) was Hazrat Umme Kulsom (RA). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: Who is referred to as 'Khatoon-e-Jannat' in Islamic history?
questions.explanation: The title 'Khatoon-e-Jannat' (Lady of Paradise) refers to Bibi Fatima (R.A) , the beloved daughter of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: How many daughters did Hazrat Khadija (RA) have with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Khadija (RA) had four daughters with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: Which of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) children was not born to Hazrat Khadija (R.A)?
questions.explanation: The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) had Hazrat Ibrahim (R.A) from Hazrat Maria Qibtiya (R.A), while all his other children were born to Hazrat Khadija (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: How many sons and daughters did the Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) have?
questions.explanation: The Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) had 3 sons and 4 daughters. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: How many sons did Prophet Muhammad ﷺ have with his first wife, Hazrat Khadija (RA)?
questions.explanation: Note: the sons were Qasim and Abdullah (Tayyib and Tahir are taken as Abdullah's titles); some sources count more. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ had 2 sons with Hazrat Khadija (RA): Hazrat Qasim and Hazrat Abdullah (also known as Tayyab/Tahir). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, children.

questions.text: The title 'Maseeh ul Islam' is associated with which Companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Note: Abu Dhar Ghifari (RA) is often called "Masih-ul-Islam" because of his asceticism. The title 'Maseeh ul Islam' (Messiah of Islam) is associated with Hazrat Abu Zar Ghaffari (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prominent sahaba r a (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: What was the real name of Hazrat Abu Huraira (RA)?
questions.explanation: The real name of Hazrat Abu Huraira (RA) was Abdul Rehman Ibne Sakhr Ad-Dausi. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prominent sahaba r a (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Who was the first companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to be buried in Jannatul Baqi?
questions.explanation: The first companion to be buried in Jannatul Baqi was Hazrat Uthman bin Mazoun (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prominent sahaba r a.

questions.text: Where is Hazrat Bilal (RA) buried?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Bilal (RA) is buried in Damascus, Syria. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prominent sahaba r a.

questions.text: Who is known by the titles Zun-Noorain and Jame-al-Quran among the following Sahaba?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Usman (RA) is known as Zun-Noorain (Possessor of Two Lights) because he married two daughters of the Prophet (PBUH) and Jame-al-Quran (Compiler of the Quran) for his role in the official compilation of the Holy Quran. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prominent sahaba r a.

questions.text: Who was responsible for liberating Amir bin Faheera?
questions.explanation: Amir bin Faheera was liberated from slavery by Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prominent sahaba r a.

questions.text: What was the name of Hazrat Abu Sufyan's daughter who married the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Abu Sufyan's daughter who married the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was Hazrat Umm Habibah (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, wives (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: What was the Kunya (nickname) of Hazrat Aisha (R.A.)?
questions.explanation: The Kunya (nickname) of Hazrat Aisha (R.A.) was Umm Abdullah. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, wives.

questions.text: Who among the following are referred to as Umm-ul-Momineen in Islamic tradition?

options.A: The daughters of the Holy Prophet (PBUH)
options.B: The wives of the Holy Prophet (PBUH)
options.C: The female companions who accepted Islam first

questions.explanation: The title Umm-ul-Momineen (Mother of the Believers) is exclusively used for the wives of the Holy Prophet (PBUH). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, wives.

questions.text: Which wife of Prophet Muhammad (P.B.U.H) was the daughter of the head of the Banu Nadir tribe?
questions.explanation: The wife of Prophet Muhammad (P.B.U.H) who was the daughter of the head of the Banu Nadir tribe was Safiya bint Huyayy. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, wives (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: What was the name of the woman from Banu Mustaliq whom Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) married?

options.B: Hazrat Umm Habiba bint Abi Sufyan (RA)

questions.explanation: The woman from Banu Mustaliq whom Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) married was Hazrat Juwayriya bint al-Harith (RA). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, wives (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: The Incident of Ifk (Slander) is related to which wife of the Holy Prophet ﷺ?
questions.explanation: The Incident of Ifk (Slander) is related to Hazrat Ayesha (RA). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, wives (marked as a past-paper MCQ).
